rss: Doing these things now will help you save money at Christmas
title: Saving Tips for Holiday Shopping
story: It's almost holiday time! Making smart choices now can help you save money for gifts and celebrations later. Plan ahead and look for deals to make your holiday budget happy!
storyBig: The holiday season can be expensive, but planning ahead and making smart financial decisions can ease the burden. Consider shopping early, looking for discounts, and setting a budget to manage your holiday expenses effectively.
think: What can you do now to save money for the holidays?
bull: Planning early can help you get the best deals.
bear: Waiting too long might mean missing out on discounts.

rss: He spent $50,000 on Labubus but now the craze is dying
title: Toy Craze Fizzles Out
story: A popular toy frenzy is slowing down. People are not as excited about collecting these toys anymore, and the company is seeing fewer sales. Sometimes trends change quickly!
storyBig: The decline in interest for a once-popular toy line has significantly impacted its parent company's revenue. Trends in the toy industry can shift rapidly, affecting both consumer interest and company performance.
think: What happens when a toy goes out of style?
bull: New toys might become the next big hit!
bear: Relying on one toy for success can be risky for companies.
